traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Drive meets imagination. Energy steered by vision and a persuasive, magnetic pull. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: Taking frantic action in a confusing situation feels much more productive than admitting you are flying blind, but motion is not the same as progress. When Mars opposes Neptune, urgency collides with mixed signals and shifting targets, turning guesswork into a strategy. Stop reacting to shadows. Slow down, separate hard data from your assumptions, and find out what is actually true before you commit your time and energy to a ghost.
